inputs.prompt: Edit the supplied KTV private-room scene into a realistic vertical commercial keyframe. Add one fictional adult East Asian AI female host standing naturally in the room, elegant and beautiful, normal face, normal hands, normal full-body proportions, tasteful black business-evening dress, confident presenter posture, soft smile, looking toward camera. nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.

| Model            | Steps | CFG |
|---------------------|---------------|---------------|
| Offical             | 50               | 4.0               
| fp8_e4m3fn             | 20                | 2.5               |
| fp8_e4m3fn + 4steps LoRA    | 4               | 1.0               |
This node is to avoid poor output results caused by excessively large input image sizes.
